title: Chapter 1472 - 13: Realization (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1472 - 13: Realization (Part 2)

Chapter 1472: Chapter 13: Realization (Part 2)

Lin Yuan slightly smiled.

"Since negotiations have failed, we’ll have to test what methods you, the Galaxy Lord, actually possess."

The terrifying being radiating infinite light solemnly said, "To show our respect, we will join forces and do our utmost."

"Yes, Galaxy Lord, if you refuse, not only will we act against you, but we will also target your kin, descendants, loved ones, and friends, using every means against you."

Another terrifying being spoke, with a tone that was cruel and domineering.

Any existence nearing the end of the transcendence road would spare no efforts for that final step.

Transcendence is right in front of them, after endless epochs of cultivation, all of one’s pursuits are about to be realized.

How could one still worry about this and that?

"Indeed, Galaxy Lord, this act, although shameless, leaves us no choice."

"Galaxy Lord, between you and us, there is no hatred nor enmity; it is entirely for our individual daos and transcendence that we use any means against you. Similarly, you can do the same against us."

The other terrifying beings spoke.

The things they are doing now far surpass any concern for shame or facade.

Lin Yuan listened quietly.

He also found that the will of the Supreme Rule Dao could not lock onto his true form climbing the white jade steps.

In other words, these terrifying beings from different time-spaces could not truly stop him from ascending the white jade steps.

At worst, he’ll abandon all external true forms, avatars, and incarnations.

However.

Doing so.

Is equivalent to giving up everything.

Chaos Void? The human race? Lord Mo Xu and other time beings? And many other Original Worlds?

They would all be found and locked onto by these terrifying beings through the guidance of the will of the Supreme Rule Dao.

Of course.

Giving up all of this is something Lin Yuan is reluctant to accept.

But when it truly comes to weighing it against transcendence.

Lin Yuan would still choose the latter without hesitation.

As long as he can transcend in the end, his deceased kin, friends, and race can all be resurrected.

Even a transcender can return to past time-spaces to change everything, shaping the future as they desire.

Lin Yuan would naturally not be swayed by these terrifying beings’ threats.

However.

This is a choice made out of necessity.

Before that, Lin Yuan still plans to try.

To see if he can repel these terrifying beings from different time-spaces.

...

Within the Chaos Void.

Lord Mo Xu and other time beings were anxiously waiting.

At that moment, an incarnation of Lin Yuan descended.

"Galaxy."

"Galaxy."

Lord Mo Xu and the other time beings immediately inquired.

"It seems negotiations won’t succeed."

Lin Yuan looked at Lord Mo Xu and the other time beings.

"Won’t succeed?"

Lord Mo Xu immediately understood what Lin Yuan meant.

"Galaxy, rest assured, when the time comes, we will not hesitate to obliterate all avatars and survival methods, leaving no opportunity for them to threaten us."

Lord Mo Xu immediately said.

As for escaping?

In the face of these existences far surpassing the Time Lords, no matter where one escapes, that time-space will be easily found.

If not for Lin Yuan’s protection, a single glance from these terrifying beings would be enough to obliterate everything.

"If I can transcend, I will resurrect you all."

After Lin Yuan said this, his incarnation quickly dissipated.

He needed to gather his full focus to face the ensuing fierce battle.

...

Outside the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan flipped his right hand and forcibly recalled the Chaos Void behind him.

At his level, even the pinnacle dimensional space could be forcibly relocated and taken away.

The many terrifying beings, upon seeing this scene, immediately knew that a confrontation was imminent.

Rustle——

In the instant when the Chaos Void is withdrawn, Lin Yuan makes his move. The Chaotic Origin Tai Yi Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Chu Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Shi Dao, and Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao instantly permeate, enveloping numerous terrifying existences.

Why didn’t they escape?

Under the lock of the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, no matter how Lin Yuan tries to escape, he is fully revealed in the perception of these terrifying existences, making escape unnecessary.

Rumble.

The four types of Chaotic Origin Dao, evolved from the "Innate Five Great," sweep in mightily.

"Such terrifying power." The terrifying existence, emitting infinite light, feels the suffocating sensation brought on by the four types of Chaotic Origin Dao, and is exceptionally shocked.

The power of this Galaxy Lord surpasses any one of them.

In a one-on-one situation, no terrifying existence can match the Galaxy Lord, unable even to maintain an unbeaten position; they would be swiftly defeated.

"Join forces."

The terrifying existence emitting infinite light glances around.

Buzz buzz buzz～ Over five hundred terrifying existences immediately strike, their majestic aura instantly forming layers of cages, encompassing Lin Yuan.

"Under the blessing of the Supreme Rule Dao’s will, all our powers can perfectly fuse together without any inner conflict dissipating..."

The terrifying existence emitting infinite light thinks to itself, equally confident.

Normally, the paths each terrifying existence takes are different, making it impossible for their powers to fuse together, like water and fire, how can they merge?

Forcing a fusion would only lead to an internal collapse, either water extinguishes fire, or fire consumes fire.

Yet, the Supreme Rule Dao’s will encompasses everything, able to contain the power of over five hundred terrifying existences.

"Hm?"

Lin Yuan frowns, as the power erupted from the four types of Chaotic Origin Dao begins to rapidly collapse under the joint forces of over five hundred terrifying existences.

"Head-on clash, I’m not the opponent."

Lin Yuan concludes in his heart that the fully fused powers of over five hundred terrifying existences have reached an inconceivable realm.

Layers of cages encompass various types of Chaotic Origin Dao, beginning to suppress Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan can only choose to withstand it head-on; his physical body is unbelievably strong, with each particle world comparable to a dimension, coupled with numerous defensive means and recovery methods.

Even if the powers of over five hundred terrifying existences fully merge, at most they can slightly suppress him, without posing any real threat.

"That’s all your means?"

Lin Yuan looks at the terrifying existences.

"That’s all your means?" The terrifying existence emitting infinite light is somewhat troubled; they’ve already given their all, yet still cannot overcome Lin Yuan.

"Give it your all."

The terrifying existence emitting infinite light immediately transmits a message.

As terrifying existences near the end of transcendence, naturally, they have many desperate means to unleash battle power far beyond their usual limit in a short time.

Rumble——

As the terrifying existences choose to give it their all, the pressure Lin Yuan bears begins to rise rapidly.

Each particle world within his flesh collapses, although simultaneously recovering, the recovery speed clearly cannot catch up with the collapse speed.

"Can’t hold on?"

Lin Yuan sighs inwardly.

Then closes his eyes.

...

Meanwhile.

On the endless white jade staircase.

Lin Yuan, who is climbing, pauses and stops.

He focuses all his mind on resisting the joint forces of over five hundred terrifying existences, having no extra energy to climb the white jade staircase.

The white jade staircase isn’t something that can be climbed at will; ascending each step requires facing terrifying compressive twisting forces and numerous illusions, as well as comprehending the subsequent direction of one’s Chaotic Origin Dao.

At this moment, Lin Yuan clearly has no energy to do so, hence he can only choose to pause and stop.

"Hm?"

Lin Yuan turns to look down, as the dissolution starting from the middle of the white jade staircase is rapidly spreading toward him.

"Do I really have to abandon everything in the external world, clansmen, homeland, friends, to achieve transcendence?" Lin Yuan remains silent.

The best choice now is to actively obliterate everything true self and avatars in the external world, and climb the white jade staircase without distraction.

"Did my future self, millions of years later, also make this choice?"

Scenes from Wanwei space-time flash through Lin Yuan’s mind when he was forced by the Blood Sea Lord to summon his future self.

At that time, the scene shown by the future self was also on the white jade staircase, the endless white jade staircase, with only the solitary figure of the future self, seemingly alone in a vast world.

And now, with the Supreme Rule Dao’s will permeating past and future, Lin Yuan can no longer summon his future self.

Lin Yuan exhaled lightly and stretched out his right hand, the power of Chaotic Origin Tai Yi Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Chu Dao, Chaotic Origin Tai Shi Dao, and Chaotic Origin Taiji Dao intertwining and colliding within.

Instantly, within Lin Yuan’s view, the power of the four types of Chaotic Origin Dao begins to diffuse, subtly nurturing the power of the fifth form of Chaotic Origin Dao.

As soon as the power of the fifth form of Chaotic Origin Dao emerges, it rapidly and perfectly merges with the previous four types of Chaotic Origin Dao, until——

Boom!!!
